discrepancies.issue: docs/omo-parity-ledger.md §4 的 S2 措辞沿用旧句（『re-runs only the changed task AND ITS DEPENDENTS』），而 frozen-contract.massUlwSemantics.S2 已将其精化为『传递依赖』并注明 resolves Planner R4F1；台账 O5 冲突注记因此已过时。
